name: Fine-Grained Accessor for Resources
description: Provides row- and column-level access control over external resources (S3 objects, blob storage, file paths). Mediates read/write requests through policy evaluation that checks subject identity, resource attributes, and intended action.
when_to_use: Multi-tenant data lakes need tenant-isolated object access
Storage layer lacks native fine-grained ACLs
drawbacks: Policy engine is a critical dependency
Risk of policy drift between engine and storage
use_cases: S3 pre-signed URLs gated by IAM policies
